pr_title: Fix osu!taiko editor operations not always updating the menu/visual state correctly
pr_comments: Tests are failing due to feedback loops in the bindable logic. Have a potential solution in the works.

Apart from fixing the conversion issue, I've also removed some duplicated specifications that were in `TaikoBeatmapConverter`. Rationale is provided in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/12916/commits/9223d85f37d33481fd0704349adaf19880728102.

issue_context.title: Taiko: Finish Toggle doesn't visually change the notes to a large DON or KAT while editting
issue_context.body:
When changing a note to a large DON or KAT, it still has the same sprite as a small don or kat

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29100055/119247095-45e8ff80-bb44-11eb-8bd6-258b97b9ca8f.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29100055/119247100-4ed9d100-bb44-11eb-85c6-8da5c97147cb.png)
Caption: They play the correct hitsounds, however both of these notes appear as their small counterparts.

Saving your masterpiece then going back to editor fixes it to the correct large notes
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29100055/119247198-e9d2ab00-bb44-11eb-825d-a8206f00b530.png)
Caption: After saving, exiting the editor then editing again

osu lazer version: 2021.523.0

Man I'm unlucky for encountering bugs every update. I reproduced this twice and tried restarting to see if it fixes itself, it doesn't.

review_comments: I've added these calls in line to match the rest, but we can potentially decide that it should be implicitly run on all items in the selection. This would be safer, but potentially increase the overhead when not all items in the selection are actually being modified (though i believe this is quite rare).
What are all of these `Update()` calls doing? Seems like this is handled via `EndChange()` from `PerformOnSelection()` anyway?

It's only handled if a modification is detected by `EditorBeatmap`. Check the flow of `batchPendingUpdates`, I'm pretty sure you'll find that it's required. Also see https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/12916#discussion_r637540972 which I explain this.
Ah, for some reason I thought I saw an add to `batchPendingUpdates` inside there and thought this was duplicating it.
